title: Same Height, Double the Weight: Dugtrio's Alolan Twist
premise: Compare standard Dugtrio and Dugtrio Alola, which share a height but not a weight.
audiencePromise: See how Alolan Dugtrio doubles the weight without growing taller, then adds a second type.
openLoop: How can two Dugtrio forms share a height but weigh so differently?
payoff: Alolan Dugtrio keeps the same height, doubles the weight, and adds Steel typing.
engagementQuestion: Same size or double weight: which version surprises you more?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and curious. Stress the contrast between same height and double weight. Pause briefly before each number, then land the final choice clearly.

scenes.headline: THE ORIGINAL MEASUREMENT
scenes.narration: Standard Dugtrio stands 0.7 meters tall and weighs 33.3 kilograms.
scenes.caption: 0.7 METERS • 33.3 KILOGRAMS

scenes.headline: THE WEIGHT SPIKE
scenes.narration: Dugtrio Alola stays 0.7 meters tall, but weighs 66.6 kilograms.
scenes.caption: SAME HEIGHT • 66.6 KILOGRAMS

scenes.headline: THE NUMBER DOUBLES
scenes.narration: Same height, but the scale jumps from 33.3 to 66.6.
scenes.caption: 33.3 KG → 66.6 KG

scenes.headline: A SECOND TYPE APPEARS
scenes.narration: Weight isn't the only change: Alolan Dugtrio also gains Steel typing.
scenes.caption: GROUND → GROUND + STEEL

scenes.headline: THE SAME-SIZE SURPRISE
scenes.narration: Same size or double weight: which version surprises you more?
scenes.caption: STANDARD OR ALOLAN?
